name: Crânio de Lobo Guará - Porção Ventral
description:
Modelo 3D de crânio de lobo-guará (*Chrysocyon brachyurus*), integrante da Coleção Didática do Laboratório de Anatomia Comparada de Vertebrados (LACV), Universidade de Brasília (UnB). O modelo apresenta a identificação de alguns elementos ósseos, permitindo a observação de características morfológicas típicas da família Canidae, como focinho alongado e dentição adaptada a uma dieta onívora.

O lobo-guará é o maior canídeo da América do Sul e uma espécie emblemática do Cerrado, onde exerce papel ecológico relevante na dispersão de sementes e no equilíbrio trófico.

Autoria: Maria Eduarda Rodrigues da Silva (UnB/LACV).
Sketchfab: @madurdg.

name: Yoshi's Wolly World Diorama 🦕🦖🧶
description:
**"Yoshi's Woolly World Diorama"** 

Este diorama es una recreación detallada y encantadora inspirada en el su respectivo videojuego de Nintendo, siendo uno de mis videojuegos favoritos. 

En el modelo, presento a varios Yoshi en un entorno vibrante y colorido, con texturas que evocan un estilo artesanal, como si todo estuviera hecho de lana y materiales suaves. Este es un modelo 3D que he realizado completamente en Blender, utilizando materiales procedurales. Posteriormente, llevé a cabo el proceso de bake para optimizarlo y poder subirlo a Sketchfab. Es un trabajo hecho con mucho mimo y cariño, que espero transmita la emoción que sentí al crearlo.

Si quieres disfrutar de este diorama con mayor resolución y detalle, puedes encontrarlo en mi ArtStation y en las imágenes que he compartido. ¡Perfecto para los amantes de Yoshi, el arte retro y lo creativo!

name: Allosaurus King of the Jurassic
description: Allosaurus was a large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period, approximately 155 to 145 million years ago. Known for its role as one of the dominant predators of its time, Allosaurus was a formidable hunter, measuring up to 12 meters (39 feet) in length and weighing around 2.5 metric tons. Its robust build featured a massive skull with dozens of sharp, serrated teeth designed for slicing through flesh. The dinosaur’s strong, muscular legs and a long tail provided balance and agility, while its relatively short but powerful arms ended in three-fingered hands equipped with large claws, ideal for grasping and holding onto prey. Allosaurus had a keen sense of sight and smell, aiding in its predatory lifestyle. Fossil evidence suggests it was a versatile carnivore, preying on a variety of herbivorous dinosaurs, and possibly engaging in pack hunting to take down larger prey.

name: Cecropia moth
description:
Hyalophora cecropia, the cecropia moth, is North America's largest native moth. It is a member of the family Saturniidae, or giant silk moths. Females have been documented with a wingspan of five to seven inches (13 to 18 cm) or more. These moths can be found predominantly across the east of North America, with occurrences as far west as Washington and north into the majority of Canadian provinces. Cecropia moth larvae are most commonly found on maple trees, but they have also been found on cherry and birch trees among many others. The species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae.

Learn more at: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyalophora_cecropia

name: Giant water bug
description:
Giant Florida Water Bug, *Lethocerus* sp.

Photogrammetry scan by the Florida Museum Digital Imaging division. https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/digital-lab/photogrammetry/

The heteropteran family Belostomatidae contains the giant water bugs. These large, predatory, aquatic insects have the largest body size among the Heteroptera. Adults of some South American species reach 4 inches in length. Individuals occur in ponds and ditches where they suspend below the surface, respiring through two abdominal appendages which act as siphons.  Individuals are capable of inflicting a painful bite with their strong beak, and may also pinch with their front legs. Individuals prey on aquatic insects, small fish, frogs, tadpoles, small birds, and other organisms they are able to capture. Powerful enzymes are injected into prey to kill them. Adults of Lethocerus are considered a delicacy in Asia, and are eaten both fresh and cooked.  - UF IFAS https://entnemdept.ufl.edu/creatures/misc/bugs/giant_water_bugs.htm

name: Dromaeosaur Figura Model
description:
This model is of a generic large Dromaeosaur, mainly based off *Utahraptor*. It was created for use in the Figura Minecraft mod as a custom player model. There are animations for virutally every player action in the game. 
In-game, coding contols tail side-to-side movement, which is why there's little of that in the model's animations themselves. Coding also takes care of blending animations together, so some are short and choppy with no transitions between them and the idle pose. Also, because of how Minecraft animations are programmed, the head and neck in the sneaking animations had to be offset in order to look normal in-game.
Here, the netherite armor is featured. There are variations of every armor, including turtle armor, in this model as well. Each looks slightly different and the stronger the armor, the cooler the design.

name: Amethystine Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

Amethystine Blight Drones are very quick and elusive, skittering about their hives gathering lichen and other cave plants. As herbivores, Amethystine drones and their Queen are largely docile, and will normally only attack when threatened or desperate.

**Other Things to Note:**  *These drones, while they normally survive on plants, have been recorded to store and eat gems and other precious minerals.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer. 
Also see: [Amethystine Blight Queen](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/amethystine-blight-queen-1a9caad333b049c3a94c7648001d2b57)

3D gorilla models are often used to represent Bigfoot or Sasquatch in games and other media due to several reasons:
Physical Similarity: Gorillas and Bigfoot share similar physical characteristics, such as a stocky, hairy body and a bipedal stance. This makes 3D gorilla models a suitable basis for creating a credible Bigfoot.
Availability and Cost: Gorilla 3D models already exist and are available in various asset libraries and 3D model marketplaces. This reduces the cost and time needed to create a 3D model of Bigfoot from scratch.
Ease of Modification: 3D gorilla models can be easily modified to fit your desired representation of Bigfoot. Artists can change the texture, color, shape and other features to create a unique model.

name: Santa Reindeer
description:
Santa’s reindeer are not ordinary *Rangifer tarandus*—they are a distinct, magical species recognized as *Rangifer volans mirabilis* (“marvelous flying reindeer”). Unlike their terrestrial cousins, these creatures possess specialized adaptations for aerial travel. Their hooves are broad and luminescent, generating lift when striking snow or clouds. A dense, iridescent coat insulates them against the freezing stratosphere, while their cardiovascular system is uniquely tuned for supersonic endurance. Most striking is their nasal bioluminescence, famously exemplified by Rudolph, which aids navigation through storms. Social by nature, *Rangifer volans mirabilis* thrive in cooperative herds, their synchronized flight patterns allowing Santa’s sleigh to glide effortlessly across the globe. In folklore and science alike, they embody resilience, teamwork, and the enduring magic of winter.

name: Caraxes – The Blood Wyrm
description:
Caraxes, famously known as The Blood Wyrm, is one of the most iconic dragons from House of the Dragon. Renowned for his long serpentine neck, lean yet muscular body, crimson-black scales, and massive bat-like wings, Caraxes possesses a unique silhouette that sets him apart from every other dragon in Westeros.

This highly detailed 3D replica captures Caraxes in a dramatic perched pose atop a ruined medieval tower, with his wings fully spread and tail wrapped around the ancient stone structure. Every scale, spine, membrane, and architectural detail has been carefully sculpted to create a premium display piece suitable for collectors, fantasy enthusiasts, tabletop dioramas, or high-quality digital showcases.

Designed with realistic textures and cinematic proportions, this model is ideal for rendering, 3D printing, game assets, and portfolio presentations inspired by the world of House of the Dragon and the Targaryen dragons.

name: Biomech Zombie War Whale
description:
A massive, hyper-detailed 3D model of a biomechanical undead whale — a terrifying fusion of military machinery, rotting organic tissue, and experimental biotech.
The creature keeps the iconic whale silhouette (giant head, long body, wide fluke) but is completely transformed into a sci-fi horror weapon.

The front half is almost fully mechanized: armored metal plating, bolted panels, vent slits, pipes, sensors, cylindrical side modules, and a submarine-like viewing hatch. Behind the head, the plating transitions into pale, diseased flesh stitched together with exposed muscle fibers, tendons, and infected green patterns.

The spine is fully exposed, lined with black biomech growths resembling mechanical fins, servos, or fungal armor. Antennas, metal probes, and sensor rods protrude from the back, enhancing the creature’s militarized experimental weapon look.

name: Ogcocephalus vespertilio - MNCN38D
description:
**Description**: As an adaptation to its benthic lifestyle, its body has evolved to be broad and depressed, while its pectoral and pelvic fins have been modified into leg-like appendages. It is distributed throughout the tropical waters of the Western Atlantic, ranging from the Antilles to Brazil. Native tribes at the mouth of the Amazon River are known to use this species for the treatment of asthma. Historical specimen, captured in the Caribbean Sea in 1886.

**Specimen**: *Ogcocephalus vespertilio* (Linnaeus, 1758).

**Inventory number**: MNCN-38D

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Ictiología. Curator: Javier Díaz (javier.diaz@mncn.csic.es).

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Find more about the collection [here](http:mncn.csic.es/es/colecciones/cientificas/ictiologia).

Scanned with an Artec Spider in 2026 by Leticia Herrera and Carlos A. Palancar.

description:
A towering swarm king horror, a manlike figure whose entire body is a densely packed writhing mass of dark rats bound together into a rough humanoid shape. Individual heads, tails and clawed paws push out of the surface everywhere, two clusters of small red eyes mark the head, and a tattered scrap of old cloak hangs from the shoulders. Two thick legs of matted interlocked vermin end in broad splayed feet bristling with protruding tails. Built with the help of AI generation and refined into a game-ready asset, it features realistic matted fur and wet vermin textures. Perfect as a plague-themed boss or elite enemy for dark fantasy, gothic and survival horror games, cinematic renders and VR projects. Standalone creature model without ground or environment.

name: World Earth Day - Mexican Salamanders
description:
Ah, *now* it's World Earth Day. Very well then!
There are about 30 different species of salamander within genus *Ambystoma* - some of the rarest living in the highlands of Mexico.
Several of these are unusual in that unlike other salamanders; who transition to a terrestrial life on land, these salamanders never do - retaining functioning gills and body fins for their entire lives.
With the continued development of many parts of Mexico, many of such species are now close to extinction.

name: Spinosaurus
description: Spinosaurus was a colossal theropod dinosaur that lived during the Cretaceous period, approximately 112 to 93 million years ago. It is one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs known, reaching lengths of up to 50 feet and weighing as much as 20 tons. Spinosaurus is renowned for its distinctive sail-like structure, formed by elongated neural spines on its back, which could have been used for display, thermoregulation, or storage of fat. Another unique feature of Spinosaurus was its crocodile-like skull, equipped with conical teeth well-suited for catching fish, indicating a semi-aquatic lifestyle. Its elongated, muscular forelimbs, equipped with large claws, suggest it was adept at catching and handling prey. Fossils of Spinosaurus have been found in North Africa, particularly in Egypt and Morocco, painting a picture of a versatile and formidable predator that thrived in both terrestrial and aquatic environments.

description:
Stórmerkilegur gripur- leikfang fannst í skálanum frá 10. öld í Firði á Seyðisfirði, útskorið dýr úr gjóskubergi. Við höllumst að því að þetta sé svín, villisvín eða björn og sumir segja hundur. Dýrið er um 5 cm að lengd og 2,7 cm að hæð. Uppgröfturinn er á vegum Antikva ehf. undir stjórn Ragnheiðar Traustadóttur.

A remarkable artefact-A toy was found in the viking age longhouse in Fjörður in Seyðisfjörður in East Iceland, a carved animal made from Palagonite tuff. We lean towards it being a pig, boar or bear and some people say dog. The animal is about 5 cm in length and 2.7 cm in height. The excavation is overseen by Antikva ehf. under the direction of Ragnheiður Traustadóttir.



Created in RealityCapture by Dag-Øyvind Solem from 142 images taken by Knut Paasche, NIKU.

description:
Smilodon, commonly known as the saber-toothed cat, was a remarkable and iconic predator that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. These large cats were characterized by their long, curved canine teeth, which were adapted for stabbing and slashing rather than simply biting.

There are several species of Smilodon, with Smilodon fatalis being one of the most well-known. These saber-toothed cats were formidable predators, likely preying on large herbivores such as bison and camels. The length of their canines indicates a specialized hunting strategy, using their impressive teeth to deliver powerful and precise bites to the necks of their prey.

Daeodon was characterized by its robust build, long legs, and a large head with powerful jaws. It had sharp teeth and was likely an opportunistic omnivore, feeding on both plant material and scavenging for meat. Despite its pig-like appearance, Daeodon was not a direct ancestor of modern pigs.

name: Enemies>Halo 3>The Flood>Pure Tank
description:
When a stalker form is cornered or confronted with well-armed opponents, it will often undergo a rapid transformation into a tank form to better defend itself. Most of the stalker's body mass shifts to the frontal body section, forming a muscular torso. The rear limbs are augmented with muscle to serve as legs, while the forelimbs become bulkier and rapidly extrude bone structures to form blade or club-like appendages. In this state, the tank form is more resistant to conventional weaponry and possesses more devastating melee capabilities, but moves at a far slower pace.

Tank forms are quite slow in comparison to combat forms, but they make up for it with relative resilience and devastating melee attacks. They can run on all fours for a short period, allowing a short burst of speed to overtake a target. Tank Forms can spew a torrent of Infection Forms from their 'mouth' as a form of short ranged attack, or in order to infect nearby corpses.

name: General Sudirman Monument
description:
Sudirman (Old Spelling: Soedirman; 24 January 1916 – 29 January 1950) was a high-ranking Indonesian military officer during the Indonesian National Revolution. The first commander of the Indonesian National Armed Forces, he continues to be widely respected in the country.

The statue of General Sudirman is one of the statues located in Jakarta precisely in the Upper Dukuh area, front of the BNI Building, Jalan Jenderal Sudirman. This statue is made of bronze weighing 4 tons with a budget of 3.5 billion Rupiah and done by artists as well as lecturers of art Institut Teknologi Bandung, SunaryoThe figure of General Sudirman is described as standing firmly respectfully and the head slightly looked up to give a dynamic impression. Because it stands in the middle of an area full of activities, the sculpture is deliberately designed simple and does not require much detail.

-Modeling and sculpting using Blender

name: Roman Shop threshold, Ostia
description:
This threshold was once the entrance to a store in Ostia. The large entrance gives people outside a good view of the interior, of the goods and the decorations, drawing them in so that they will hopefully spend money. The threshold creates a clear distinction between the outside and the shopping space, putting shoppers in a mindset to shop as soon as they step in. This threshold in particular opens onto a mosaic. Not only were mosaics decorative and beautiful they were also signifiers of wealth thus they made the shop desirable for not only its appearance but also for it's success.The threshold not only creates a clear seperation with the shop and the outside world, it also has a groove where shop owners would put boards to lock up at the end of the night.



Created in Metashape for the Virtual Roman Retail project with the permission of the Parco
Archeologico di Ostia Antica.

Original=86.82MB Decimated=72.22MB

name: Vintage Wooden Desk – Ornamental | Game Ready
description:
This is a realistic vintage wooden desk created for game environments and real-time rendering.

The focus of this project was to capture the aged wooden surface, subtle wear, and ornamental detailing while maintaining a clean and optimized mesh suitable for real-time applications. Special attention was given to material breakup, edge wear, and surface imperfections to achieve a believable, slightly worn look.

The model includes decorative panel detailing and metallic drawer handles, adding character and storytelling to the asset.

Key Features:
• Game-ready optimized geometry
• Clean topology and efficient UV layout
• High-quality PBR textures (Base Color, Roughness, Metallic, Normal, AO)
• Detailed wood grain with realistic wear and aging
• Decorative ornamental panel for added visual interest
• Suitable for Unity, Unreal Engine, and real-time rendering

This asset is ideal for interior environments, vintage scenes, and cinematic setups.

Created using Blender, RizomUV and Substance Painter.

La Celebrazione del Volume. Verticalità Imponente per il Design Architettonico.

Pylon nasce dall'esigenza di creare un punto focale che elevi lo sguardo e definisca la solennità dello spazio. Mantenendo la base geometrica netta del calice, Pylon estende il suo piedistallo in una colonna imponente, trasformandosi in un vero e proprio pilastro scultoreo. È il vaso ideale per scandire la ritmicità degli spazi pubblici, celebrare l'ingresso di un edificio o definire gli assi visivi in grandi giardini e terrazze panoramiche. Pylon è l'elemento che conferisce peso visivo e verticalità assoluta al progetto.
